svg.title: At the NASA station, a drone that stays on the moving beam would be 43 dB over the allowance; drones under normal conditions are 50 dB under it

cc:Work.dc:title: At the NASA station, a drone that stays on the moving beam would be 43 dB over the allowance; drones under normal conditions are 50 dB under it
cc:Work.dc:description: Dumbbell chart with one row per station. For the NASA Wallops station, the worst case sits at +43 dB and normal conditions at -50 dB relative to the allowance; for CCNY, +43 dB and -25 dB. Small markers show the all-time basis and the 20 dB apportionment cases. Only the worst case is above the allowance line at 0 dB.
